answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the voyage of a task receipt, and the signal is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the timber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
